rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REGULATE THE PRICES OF MATRICULATION, TUITION AND OTHER SCHOOL FEES IN ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SCHOOLS NATIONWIDE, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE A SCHOOL FEE BOARD IN ALL SCHOOL LEVELS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: School Fees Regulation Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"School Fees Regulation Act of 2004.\" The bill proposes the creation of the School Fee Board in all levels in public and private schools to monitor, study, evaluate and regulate matriculation, tuition and other school fees.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C009
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE JOLO FISHERIES TECHNICAL COLLEGE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF JOLO, PROVINCE OF SULU AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE 2ND PANGASINAN ENGINEERING DISTRICT SUB-OFFICE, DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS  AND HIGHWAYS LOCATED IN THE THIRD CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT OF THE PROVINCE OF PANGASINAN INTO A REGULAR ENGINEERING DISTRICT TO BE KNOWN AS THE FOURTH PANGASINAN ENGINEERING DISTRICT OFFICE AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB04414

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE CHURCH AND THE VICINITY WHERE THE ICON OF SENOR DIVINO TESORO IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CALASIAO, PROVINCE OF PANGASINAN, AS A TOURIST ONE AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2004-08-03

rows.title_full: AN ACT RENAMING PENNSYLVANIA AVENUE IN THE CITY OF SAN FERNANDO, PROVINCE OF LA UNION, GOVERNOR JOAQUIN L. ORTEGA AVENUE
rows.title_short: Renaming Pennsylvania Avenue in the City of San Fernando, La Union, Governor Joaquin L. Ortega Avenue

republic_act.title: AN ACT RENAMING PENNSYLVANIA AVENUE IN THE CITY OF SAN FERNANDO, PROVINCE OF LA UNION AS GOVERNOR JOAQUIN L. ORTEGA AVENUE

rows.author: C093
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING POLICIES GOVERNING THE HOUSEHOLD EMPLOYMENT INDUSTRY, ESTABLISHING A STANDARD OF PROTECTION AND PROMOTING THE WELFARE OF HOUSEHOLD HELPERS
rows.title_short: Magna Carta for Household Helpers or Batas Kasambahay
rows.abstract: \"Magna Carta for Household Helpers\" or \"Batas Kasambahay\". To ensure the protection and well-being of both the employer and the household helper, the bill provides for the terms and conditions of employment of the kasambahay, i.e. minimum wage requirement, payment of 13 month pay, membership to the Social Security System and the Philhealth, working hours and days, and vacation leaves and other benefits.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C029
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-09-26, transmitted to on 2006-10-05 and received by the Senate on 2006-10-05
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SECONDARY SCHOOL IN THE MUNICIPALITY PADADA, PROVINCE OF DAVAO DEL SUR TO BE KNOWN AS PADADA NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB05569

rows.author: C029
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-10-13, transmitted to on 2006-10-26 and received by the Senate on 2006-10-26
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING SIBULAN NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF STA. CRUZ, DAVAO DEL SUR AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB05599

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING ALL MOBILE AND LANDLINE TELEPHONE COMPANIES OPERATING IN THE PHILIPPINES TO REGISTER UNDER THE DEPARTMENT OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY (DTI) AND THE BUREAU OF INTERNAL REVENUE (BIR) ALL MANUFACTURED OR IMPORTED PREPAID CARDS PRIOR TO THEIR DISTRIBUTION AND/OR SALE AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: At present, the sale of prepaid cards for cellular and landline telephones are not subjected to any taxes. The bill requires all telephone companies to register with the Department of Trade and Industry and the Bureau of Internal Revenue all prepaid cards prior to sale to enable the BIR to collect the correct taxes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2005-02-02

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09433) enacted on 2007-04-11
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MAGNA CARTA FOR SOCIAL WORKERS AND SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT WORKERS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Magna Carta for Social Workers and Social Welfare and Development Workers
rows.abstract: \"Magna Carta for Social Workers and Social Welfare and Development Workers.\" The bill provides for their compensation and benefits, the payment of overtime, defines their rights and prohibits their reassignment without justification.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04536

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-12-04, transmitted to on 2006-12-07 and received by the Senate on 2006-12-07
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROHIBIT ELECTED AND APPOINTED PUBLIC OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES, INCLUDING THOSE OFFICIALS OF GOVERNMENT-OWNED AND CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS (GOCCS) AND THEIR SPOUSES FROM ENTERING, PLAYING AND PATRONIZING CASINOS AND OTHER SIMILAR ESTABLISHMENTS, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Decency in Public Service Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Decency in Public Service Act of 2004.\" To foster high ethical standards and morality in the service, the bill bans all public officials and employees from entering, playing and patronizing casinos operated by the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation and by private entities. The prohibition also extends to the spouses of public officials and employees since they are viewed as the alter ego or extension of public servants.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05565

rows.author: C020
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT RA09347 (Lapsed into law on 2006-07-27)
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO RATIONALIZE THE COMPOSITION AND FUNCTIONS OF THE NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS COMMISSION, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLES 213, 214, 215, AND 216 OF P.D. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to increase the members of the National Labor Relations Commission from fourteen to twenty three members with eight members each coming from the nominees of the workers and employers organizations. Likewise, the existing five divisions of the Commission shall be increased to eight.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05015

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE MANDATORY SUBMISSION OF THE ANNUAL BUDGETS OF GOVERNMENT-OWNED AND/OR CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS TO THE CONGRESS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill provides for all government-owned and controlled corporations (GOCCs) to submit their respective annual budgets to the Congress for approval within thirty days from the opening of every regular session. It further stipulates that GOCCs shall not incur any obligation or make any payment for current operating or capital expenditures without a budget approval by Congress and the President.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT FOR THE PRESERVATION OF PHILIPPINE ANTIQUITIES
rows.title_short: The Antiquities Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Antiquities Act of 2004.\" The country's artistic and historic wealth constitute our cultural treasure. The bill seeks to protect and regulate the disposition of such cultural treasure. It grants the National Museum jurisdiction over ruins, archaeological sites, historic and prehistoric monuments and structures, and objects of antiquity.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROHIBIT ANY MEMBER OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE (PNP) FROM DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY ARRANGING, INITIATING OR INSTIGATING ANY FINANCIAL SETTLEMENT BETWEEN THE VICTIM AND THE ACCUSED IN CASES INVOLVING SEXUAL ABUSES/OFFENSES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, ENTITLED \"AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE UNDER A REORGANIZED DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES\", AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The bill defines the responsibilities and authority of the Philippine National Police in regard to the apprehension of offenders of sexual abuse or crimes. It prohibits any police personnel to directly or indirectly arrange, initiate or cause any out-of-court financial settlement between the victim and the perpetrator in cases involving sexual abuses/offenses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE THE PROTECTION AND CONSERVATION OF THE NATIONAL HERITAGE, THE CREATION OF A NATIONAL HERITAGE COMMISSION, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: National Heritage Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"National Heritage Act of 2004.\" The bill proposes the creation of the National Heritage Commission  which shall be charged with the following functions, among others: a) to establish policies for the identification, recording and management of heritage resources; b) to promulgate rules and regulations pertaining to conservation; and c) to administer funding of conservation projects.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A CEILING ON ALL PUBLIC DEBTS OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Public Debt Ceiling Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Public Debt Ceiling Act of 2004.\" In view of the ballooning public debt of the national government and in order not to hamper the delivery of basic social services, the bill proposes to impose a ceiling on the total public debt in the amount of PhP1.2 trillion.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO IMPOSE STIFFER PENALTIES ON GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL AND OFFICIALS STATIONED AT VARIOUS EMBASSIES AND CONSULAR OFFICES ABROAD FOR GROSS NEGLIGENCE TO ACT ON COMPLAINTS OF, OR TO GIVE ASSISTANCE OR RENDER SERVICE ESPECIALLY TO DISTRESSED MIGRANT FILIPINOS AND OFWS, THEIR FAMILIES AND DEPENDENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8042, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"MIGRANT WORKERS AND OVERSEAS FILIPINOS ACT OF 1995\"
rows.abstract: The bill seeks to penalize negligent embassy and consular personnel with suspension from office for not less than ninety days without pay or dismissal from the service with forfeiture of retirement and other benefits and disqualification from public office.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2005-01-12

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTITUTIONALIZE A COMPULSORY ON-THE-JOB TRAINING (OJT) AS PART OF THE CURRICULAR PROGRAMS REQUISITE PRIOR TO GRADUATION
rows.title_short: OJT Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"OJT Act of 2004,\" The bill seeks to institutionalize the OJT program to supplement the academic training of our students in order to arm them with actual work experience in the industry where they intend to belong to.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTITUTE A PROGRAM FOR THE CONTINUING EDUCATION OF TERTIARY TEACHERS, AMENDING FOR SUCH PURPOSE R.A. NO. 7784, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"AN ACT TO STRENGTHENING TEACHER EDUCATION IN THE PHILIPPINES BY ESTABLISHING CENTERS OF EXCELLENCE, CREATING A TEACHER EDUCATION COUNCIL FOR THE PURPOSE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to require private and public university and college teachers to under a training program in order to improve the quality of tertiary education in the country. The program shall focus on proper teaching methods and other areas of study where continuing education is necessary.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE STRICT LABELLING OF FOOD AND BEVERAGE PRODUCTS BY MANUFACTURING AND DISTRIBUTION COMPANIES
rows.title_short: Consumer Information and Protection Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Consumer Information and Protection Act of 2004.\" The measure requires all manufacturers and distributors of food and beverages in the country to provide the following information on the labels of their respective products: ingredient list, additives, genetic modification, minimum durability indication, net content, nutritional labeling, and information on country of origin, manufacturers, packers and local sole agent.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE TEACHING OF HUMAN RIGHTS AS MANDATORY IN ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SCHOOLS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the Department of Education (DepEd) to include in the curricula of all private and public schools courses on human rights. The DepEd shall consult with the Commission on Human Rights on the writing, printing and publication of textbooks, manuals and other reading materials to be used in said courses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE SHOWING OF TELEVISION ADVERTISEMENTS FEATURING SEX AND/OR VIOLENCE TO CHILDREN OF TENDER AGE
rows.title_short: Television Advertisement Regulation Act of 2001
rows.abstract: \"Television Advertisement Regulation Act of 2001.\" The bill restricts the airing on television of movie advertisements or trailers depicting violence and/or sex only to such times when children of formative years are not usually watching television.
rows.status: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2005-05-20

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2005-05-20

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING AND PENALIZING CRIMES AGAINST INTERNATIONAL HUMANITARIAN LAW, ADOPTING CORRESPONDING PRINCIPLES OF CRIMINAL RESPONSIBILITY, OPERATIONALIZING UNIVERSAL JURISDICTION, DESIGNATING SPECIAL COURTS, AND FOR RELATED PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Philippine Statute on Crimes Against International Humanitarian Law
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Statute on Crimes Against International Humanitarian Law.\" The country's existing criminal laws do not adopt the terms of reference of the International Humanitarian Law and International Criminal Law. The bill seeks to empower the special courts in the country to try cases involving grave crimes such as genocide, crimes against humanity, war crimes, grave breaches of specific United Nations Conventions and other crimes against international humanitarian law.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH CERTAIN LIMITATIONS ON ADVERTISING RELATING TO CIGARETTES AND TOBACCO PRODUCTS
rows.title_short: Tobacco Products Control Act
rows.abstract: \"Tobacco Products Control Act.\" The bill seeks to impose certain restrictions in the advertisement of cigarettes and other tobacco products using billboards and periodicals in stadia and arenas, on trains, buses, train stations and terminals, in motion pictures, in video games and in family amusement centers.
rows.status: Tabled by the Committee on 2005-04-26

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE TRANSFER OF OFFENDERS TO OR FROM FOREIGN COUNTRIES
rows.title_short: Transfer of Prisoners Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Transfer of Prisoners Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to authorize the Secretary of Justice to receive custody of a Filipino offender or cause the transfer of an alien serving sentence in Philippine penitentiaries in accordance with prisoner transfer treaties. It provides for a procedure in securing the offender's consent to his transfer.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE LIQUOR MANUFACTURER AND/OR DISTRIBUTOR TO PUT ALL LIQUOR BOTTLE A WARNING LABEL THAT ALCOHOL INTAKE DURING PREGNANCY IS HAZARDOUS TO THE LIFE AND HEALTH OF THE UNBORN CHILD
rows.abstract: The bill requires the printing on the label of all liquor bottles of a warning on the hazardous effect of alcohol intake on the life and health of the unborn. Penalties for violation shall range from PhP5,000.00 to PhP50,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR SCHOLARSHIPS AND OTHER BENEFITS FOR PUBLIC AND PRIVATE SCHOOL TEACHERS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill provides for the creation of a scholarship fund to cover the tuition and other regular school fees, including textbooks, of public and private school teachers who wish to enroll in graduate and post graduate courses within the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Public School Teachers' Scholarship Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Public School Teachers' Scholarship Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to create a Public School Teachers Scholarship Fund to cover the tuition and other school fees, including textbooks, school supplies, transportation expenses and monthly living allowance, of public school teachers who wish to enroll in graduate and post-graduate courses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING INCENTIVES TO PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS WHO ARE ASSIGNED OUTSIDE OF THEIR TOWNS AND PROVINCES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Public School Teachers Incentives Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Public School Teachers Incentives Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to grant a P1,500.00 monthly incentive allowance to public school teachers assigned to a school located in another municipality other than the municipality of his residence and a P3,000.00 monthly allowance if assigned to another province other than the province of his residence.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2005-02-02

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO GRANT PUBLIC SHCOOL TEACHERS FREE OF CHARGE X-RAY AND OTHER FORMS OF LABORATORY EXAMINATIONS IN ANY GOVERNMENT AND PRIVATE HOSPITALS DURING THEIR REQUIRED ANNUAL PHYSICAL EXAMINATION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Free Physical Examination for Public School Teachers Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Free Physical Examination for Public School Teachers Act of 2004.\" In order to relieve teachers of additional costs during the mandatory annual physical examination, the bill seeks to grant teachers free x-ray and other laboratory examinations in government and private hospitals.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO RESTRICT THE ACCESS OF YOUTH TO CIGARETTES AND OTHER TOBACCO PRODUCTS
rows.title_short: Control Youth Access to Tobacco Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Control Youth Access to Tobacco Act of 2004. To protect the youth from the harmful effects of cigarette smoking, the bill limits the sale of tobacco products through vending machines to establishments where individuals below 18 years old (the proposed minimum age for the purchase of cigarettes) are not given access. It requires retail outlets selling cigarettes to prominently display a sign indicating the minimum age requirement.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C020
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REGULATE THE OPERATION OF ALL REVIEW CENTERS FOR BOARD AND OTHER FORMS OF LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL PROFESSIONAL EXAMINATIONS NATIONWIDE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Review Centers Regulation Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Review Centers Regulation Act of 2004.\" The bill mandates the Commission on Higher Education to establish a system of registration and accreditation of public and private review centers which offer review classes, seminars and programs to prepare for a professional board examination.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C101
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL COMMISSION ON MUSLIM FILIPINOS, DEFINING ITS POWERS, FUNCTIONS, AND RESPONSIBILITIES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: An Act Creating the National Commission on Muslim Filipinos
rows.abstract: \"An Act Creating the National Commission on Muslim Filipinos.\" The bill prescribes the Commission's organizational structure, powers, functions and responsibilities. The Commission is envisioned to take over the functions of the Office of Muslim Affairs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on MUSLIM AFFAIRS since 2005-08-03

rows.author: C105
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 26 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292, OHTERWISE KNOWN AS THE ADMINSTRATIVE CODE OF 1987
rows.abstract: To foster unity and political economic stability in the country, the bill proposes to include the Iglesia ni Kristo Foundation Day observed in July 27 of every year and the Last Day of Ramadan (movable date) among the regular non-working holidays in the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C122
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROVIDENT PERSONAL SAVINGS PLAN KNOWN AS THE PERSONAL EQUITY AND RETIREMENT ACCOUNT (PERA)
rows.abstract: same as HB00094
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C122
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROMOTION OF BIO-ORGANIC FARMING IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: The bill proposes to establish a comprehensive bio-organic farming program through the propagation of bio-organic cultivation and production methods. It also seeks the creation of a Bio-Organic Farming Commission that shall be tasked to implement the program.
rows.status: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2005-03-15

Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2005-03-15

rows.author: C122
rows.title_full: THE MAGNA CARTA FOR PRIVATE SCHOOL TEACHERS
rows.title_short: Magna Carta for Private School Teachers
rows.abstract: \"Magna Carta for Private School Teachers.\" The bill seeks to give private school teachers the following: a) security of tenure, b) the right against discrimination, c) academic freedom, d) the right to self-organization, and e) benefits related to health and study leaves.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C122
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN AND REFORM THE SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN, AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: The Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Law of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Law of 2004.\" The bill seeks to broaden the base of the katipunan ng kabataan by amending the maximum age of membership from 21 years old to 23 years old. It likewise proposes to amend the age requirement for sangguniang kabataan officials from \"at least fifteen (15) years but not over twenty one (21) years of age\" to \"AT LEAST EIGHTEEN (18) BUT NOT MORE THAN TWENTY THREE (23) YEARS OF AGE.\"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2004-08-03

rows.author: C122
rows.mother_status: Business for the day on 2006-12-11
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE DRINKING WATER BUSINESSES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Drinking Water Business Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Drinking Water Business Act of 2004.\" The bill seeks to protect the health and welfare of the public by regulating the drinking water business to ensure that they comply with health standards.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05913

rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-10-13, transmitted to on 2006-10-26 and received by the Senate on 2006-10-26
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN BARANGAY SINAGGUYAN, MUNICIPALITY OF DON CARLOS, PROVINCE OF BUKIDNON, TO BE KNOWN AS THE DON CARLOS NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB05652

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN BARANGAY KITUBO, MUNICIPALITY OF KITAOTAO, PROVINCE OF BUKIDNON, TO BE KNOWN AS THE KITUBO NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB06081

rows.author: C122
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2005-06-06, transmitted to on 2005-07-25 and received by the Senate on 2005-08-02
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH A SOCIALIZED AND LOW-COST HOUSING LOAN RESTRUCTURING PROGRAM, PROVIDING THE MECHANISMS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: same as HB00241
rows.status: Substituted by HB03835

rows.author: C122
rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING THE USE OF CELLULAR PHONES IN AIRPLANES
rows.title_short: The Cellular Phone Ban in Airplanes Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Cellular Phone Ban in Airplanes Act of 2004,\" The use of cellular phones while on board an airplane is dangerous since they emit electro-magnetic frequencies which interfere, alter or jam computer programmed precision instruments. For the safety of passengers, the bill declares as unlawful for any person to use cellular phones upon boarding an airplane within the Philippine territory and during the entire flight.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2005-02-14

rows.author: C122
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CENTER FOR TEACHER'S EXCELLENCE ALL THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill mandates the Department of Education, in coordination with the Commission Higher Education, to establish, operate and maintain a Center for Teachers' Excellence that shall be charged to develop and maintain a continuing program to upgrade the skills of teachers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2004-08-03

rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2006-04-05, transmitted to on 2006-04-25 and received by the Senate on 2006-04-25
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE POCTOY NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF TORRIJOS, PROVINCE OF MARINDUQUE AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB04775

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN BARANGAY MASAGUISI, MUNICIPALITY OF STA. CRUZ, PROVINCE OF MARINDUQUE TO BE KNOWN AS THE MASAGUISI NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB04822

rows.title_short: Establishing the Cabuyo National High School in Torrijos, Marinduque

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FIXED MONTHLY HONORARIA AND OTHER BENEFITS TO ACCREDITED BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 6 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7883, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS INCENTIVES AND BENEFITS ACT OF 1995

rows.abstract: To discourage criminals from preying on foreigners, the bill seeks to declare the foreign nationality of the victim as an aggravating circumstance in crimes against persons, property and liberty in crimes committed against foreign nationals.
